scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB,ADMIN -c blue,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w admin
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src frontend/tests admin/src admin/tests backend/src backend/test *.json *.js *.md frontend/*.js frontend/*.json frontend/*.html admin/*.js admin/*.json admin/*.html backend/*.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend/src frontend/tests admin/src admin/tests backend/src backend/test *.json *.js *.md frontend/*.js frontend/*.json frontend/*.html admin/*.js admin/*.json admin/*.html backend/*.json
